household.title: Household & profile
household.localBody: Without a connected database, recipes and the list stay in this browser. Connect Supabase to share everything across devices.
household.localJoinHint: In local mode, invites only work within the same browser.
household.sharedHint: Members share the Recipe Box, folders and grocery list – live on every device.

settings.title: Settings

notif.granted: On – you'll be notified when a timer ends.
notif.denied: Blocked. Allow notifications in your browser settings.

settings.notifHint: On iPhone, notifications only work after adding the app to your Home Screen.
settings.syncCloud: Connected – your data is shared live across all devices.
settings.syncLocal: Local mode – data stays in this browser.

install.title: Install the app
install.headline: Put Küchen Fusion on your Home Screen
install.body: No app store needed: it opens full screen, works offline and alerts you when timers end.
install.ios1: Open this page in Safari and tap “Share”.
install.android2: Choose “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”.
install.desktop1: In Chrome or Edge, click the install icon in the address bar.
install.shareHint: Tip: once installed, share recipes from Instagram or your browser straight to Küchen Fusion (Android).
install.shareText: Install Küchen Fusion – our shared recipe box and grocery list.

branding.title: Logo proposals
branding.intro: Four proposals for the Küchen Fusion logo: “KF” in Fraktur, black and white. The letters are converted to outlines, so they work without the font.

kf-circle.name: Seal
kf-circle.body: White KF on a black disc – bold and legible at small sizes. Basis of the app icon.

kf-tile.name: Bookplate
kf-tile.body: Black KF inside a double rule, like an ex-libris stamp.

kf-wordmark.name: Wordmark
kf-wordmark.body: Monogram and full name in Fraktur, separated by a hairline – for headers and print.

kf-plate.name: Plate
kf-plate.body: KF on a dinner plate, with the name running around the rim.
